import os
from json import loads

def imported(raw):
    parsed = loads(raw)
    # ruleid: lintro.python.none-coercion.decoded-get-default
    return parsed.get("key", [])


def direct(raw):
    # ruleid: lintro.python.none-coercion.decoded-get-default
    return json.loads(raw).get("key", {})


def constants(raw):
    CONSTANT_TABLE = json.loads(raw)
    # ok: lintro.python.none-coercion.decoded-get-default
    return CONSTANT_TABLE.get("key", 0)


def ordinary_mapping(data):
    # ok: lintro.python.none-coercion.decoded-get-default
    return data.get("key", 0)
